name: SK_ID_BUREAU
details: Recoded ID of Credit Bureau credit (unique coding for each application) - use this to join to CREDIT_BUREAU table [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: MONTHS_BALANCE
details: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the freshest balance date) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: STATUS
details: Status of Credit Bureau loan during the month (active, closed, DPD0-30,… [C means closed, X means status unknown, 0 means no DPD, 1 means maximal did during month between 1-30, 2 means DPD 31-60,… 5 means DPD 120+ or sold or written off ] )
